responsibility: This file implements the front-end machinery for Fortran 2003/2008 object-oriented features centered on CLASS polymorphism and type-bound procedures. It manages insertion and repair of hidden class-container component references such as _data and _vptr, constructs and finds vtable symbols for derived and intrinsic dynamic types, supports class initialization and metadata queries, and resolves lookup through inheritance for type-bound procedures, operators, finalization support, and related runtime descriptors used later by resolution and lowering.
